As Usg (USG) Market Valuation Rose, Asset Management Advisors Decreased Stake; Oldfield Partners Llp Has Upped Its Holding in Sk Telecom Co LTD (SKM) by $1.55 Million as Market Value Declined
May 20, 2018 - By Gary Bell
Oldfield Partners Llp increased its stake in Sk Telecom Co Ltd (SKM) by 2.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oldfield Partners Llp bought 57,250 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.66% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.79M shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $77.95M, up from 2.74 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oldfield Partners Llp who had been investing in Sk Telecom Co Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $14.53B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.04% or $0.01 $23.02. About 340,084 shares traded. SK Telecom Co., Ltd. (NYSE:SKM) has declined 9.74% downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.29% the S&P500.
Asset Management Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Usg Corporation (USG) by 16.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Asset Management Advisors Llc sold 33,180 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.67% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 166,328 shares of the building materials company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.41M, down from 199,508 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Asset Management Advisors Llc who had been investing in Usg Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.79 billion market cap company.
